scope: Only the original 36 m representative reach. Material deposition associations follow the existing eight authored landforms; no surveyed sediment or hydraulic transport claim.

installation.order: After createTerrainMaterial has installed surface41 and adopted facies44; before initial shader compilation where possible.
installation.off: Dormant default leaves original hooks, cache key and shader text unchanged. First true installs the hook; later false is a same-program uniform A/B. dispose restores the previous hook/key if still owned.
installation.diagnostic: RGB = unchanged original substrate / fine mineral / fine organic share. Active only inside original reachBed and only while candidate is enabled.
installation.worker: A new URL flag is currently unknown to the strict Worker policy. Root must either use the debug API for review or separately add only a strict binary render-only flag; this task did not modify that policy.

material.field: Existing eight root/humus/sand/gravel anchors. Sand/humus footprints widen along their existing directions; coarse gravel core is protected. Physical clearance and actual shore distance restrict new material to water-side bed; a 6 cm horizontal blend returns to original at the water boundary.
material.weights: One nonnegative, normalized vec3 controls original/fine mineral/fine organic colour, gradient and roughness.
material.grain: Original 2.9 m coarse scan remains unchanged wherever exposed. New fine layers use existing filtered soil samples with their own normal and roughness. No scan downscaling, global blur, new light term, or colour-only tint over the old rock normal.
material.geometry: No heights, root positions, scales, water width, independent stones, terrain vertex shader, or source contact data are changed.

cost.extraFieldEvaluation: At most 8 oriented footprint evaluations per eligible water-bed fragment, plus scalar partition arithmetic; domain/disabled branches avoid this outside the reach. Not a measured GPU cost.

checks: Default OFF complete shader/hook/key equality; live uniform switch and exact dispose restoration.
Original facies44 exterior-bank recovery and source scan scale retained; vertex text, sampler count and texture-call count unchanged.
CPU and emitted GLSL scalar mixing formulas agree across 1452 combinations. This is host-side formula validation, not driver Float32/GLSL compilation.
Actual 923 section samples retain exact same-parameter water width/left/right/level and ground height.
521 prepared identities and source/prepared bytes unchanged. No plant geometry was rebuilt or simplified.

distribution.scope: CPU actual default49 71 stations x 13 transverse samples; meso fixed .5 for classification, not a rendered image or GPU measurement

limitations: No browser shader compilation, screenshots, GPU timing, or visual acceptance in this task.
CPU sample meso is fixed at .5; counts describe sampled classifications, not exact screen areas or current texture-dependent material coverage.
The new fine sediment appearance is a material design using existing sources, not a new scan or validated local sediment survey.
The known half-metre root-mat render-contact mismatch remains OFF and is not solved or hidden here.
Fine deposition may still need art adjustment in whole-bend/pool-cross; numerical coverage is not approval.

criteria: Whole bend no longer reads as one continuous coarse gravel road, without substituting a continuous brown stripe.
Fine shelves and coarse exposure remain legible together at pool-cross, with original gravel scale and light response.
Original rooted top, exterior soil and all 521 contact-ready roots remain intact; OFF recovery matches the baseline.
